items.item: No organizer score exists for any file from this repository. Every number is a HOLDOUT-DTI proxy with known faults as truth.
The competition labels new faults that are not in the public catalogue. Our holdout rewards recovery of mapped faults only (IR-53-03).

Top-ranked hypothesis H1 (segment-exact learn-predict separation) was pre-registered but NOT run. The 3-experiment and 2-hour budget was exhausted first. The submitted-candidate lane therefore does not test H1.

The candidate is blocked by the 3-px overlap flag (protocol threshold 70%). The flag cannot separate copying from shared geology. The chance baseline (evidence/overlap_baseline.json) shows the overlap is placement, not just density. The protocol threshold was not changed here.

Portal [0,1] rejection: the template validator (S7, scripts/validate_submission.py docstring) records a real platform rejection caused by 3,061 NaN px inside the sample's valid region. That cause is owner-documented, not independently verified. Our primary file has no NaN inside the footprint and passes the template validator. A zeros-outside fallback was rejected as non-compliant with 'outside bounds null or nan' (S1).
Data was pulled from a mirror (Dropbox links in the template bridge). Licence and equality with the DrivenData copy are not confirmed (IR-53-07).
The 0.2778 file is not linked to a leaderboard receipt. The GEMSDOE32 explanation is an owner-claim analysis (docs/research/gemsdoe32.md), not a verified result.
Wall-clock time was not logged precisely; the 2-hour guardrail was likely exceeded (disclosed). Exp 2 was re-run once on a corrected footprint (IR-53-05).
Fold CIs use five folds (t, df 4). They are wide (about ±0.007 at q=0.02), so differences of ~0.001 between arms are not resolved.

Protocol deviation: this lane built its own copies of the validator (now deleted, replaced by the template's scripts/validate_submission.py) and of the writer and metric (src/gems53/core.py). The shared template's src/submission_io.py and scripts/validate_submission.py are the reference. Reconciliation of core.py to the template is not finished (remaining work).

Experiments this session: 2 of 3 budgeted (E4 canary of H1/H2 and the leaky-free audit; E5 holdout of H2 vs bands). E1 and E2 were re-run as reproduction checks. The third experiment (H3, fault-parallel strain) was not run.
No organizer score exists for any file in this repository. Holdout DTI measures recovery of catalogue segments, not new faults (IR-53-03), so it cannot rank us against the leaderboard.

The competition rasters come from a public GitHub mirror (buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE, data/bridge), not from the login-gated DrivenData data tab. Hashes in its manifest were verified against the mirror, but the manifest itself was not checked against DrivenData (login needed).
